headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of October 21, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 26.66%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark, which returned 14.24%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 12.43%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved a return of 37.71%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned only 2.51%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. This relative strength against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's performance. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
